title: Petition of D's Inc., d/b/a King's Transport for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity under the provisions of Section 7, Chapter 159A of the Massachusetts General Laws to authorize the transportation of passengers in motor vehicles for hire over the public ways in the Cities of Boston, Marlborough, Newton, Waltham and Watertown and the Towns of Northborough, Sudbury, Wayland and Weston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
